title: High-Dimensional Online Change Point Detection with Adaptive Thresholding and Interpretability
abstract: arXiv:2609.24278v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Change point detection (CPD) identifies abrupt and significant changes in sequential data, with applications in human activity recognition, financial markets, cybersecurity, manufacturing, and autonomous systems. Traditional CPD methods often face computational challenges in high-dimensional settings and typically provide limited explanations for detected changes, which can restrict their practical usability. This paper introduces a CPD framework that improves scalability and interpretability by leveraging the Sliced Wasserstein (SW) distance. translated_title: 基于自适应阈值与可解释性的高维在线变点检测
translated_abstract: 变点检测（CPD）用于识别序列数据中突然且显著的变化，其应用涵盖人类活动识别、金融市场、网络安全、制造业和自主系统等领域。传统的CPD方法在高维场景下常常面临计算上的挑战，并且通常对检测到的变化只能提供有限的解释，这可能限制其实际可用性。本文提出了一种通过利用切片Wasserstein（SW）距离来提升可扩展性和可解释性的CPD框架。我们的贡献有四个方面：（1）我们使用SW距离将多元序列数据转换为一维分数，使所得表示与现有CPD方法兼容；（2）我们分析了SW距离随机切片的分布行为，并证明在适当假设下其可用Gamma分布近似，从而提供了一个有原则的基（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出了一种基于切片Wasserstein距离的高维在线变点检测框架，通过将多元序列数据降维为一维分数并利用Gamma分布近似实现自适应阈值，同时提升了检测的可扩展性与可解释性。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a high-dimensional online change point detection framework based on the Sliced Wasserstein distance, which transforms multivariate sequential data into one-dimensional scores with Gamma-distribution-based adaptive thresholding, improving both scalability and interpretability.
